arguments.question: Assess whether commodity and hardware-input channels materially affect ANET over 5, 21 and 63 sessions. Focus narrowly on semiconductor/optical-component availability and pricing, inventory or purchase commitments, freight/energy effects only if evidenced, and whether supplier constraints could alter revenue timing or margins. Use substantive issuer disclosures already registered; distinguish material input or commitment evidence from generic commodity speculation. Required deliverable: concise sourced mechanism, competing explanation, gaps, and an observable reversal condition. Stop if disclosures do not support a material quantified commodity channel; report that limitation rather than broaden the search.
arguments.decision_impact: Determine whether a distinct commodities/input-cost dependency belongs in the final thesis or can be omitted as immaterial relative to company, macro, technical and policy drivers.
